description: Use this when the user wants a shareable invite link to one of their funds to stop working. Starts revoking it. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed revocation for the user to confirm. This call revokes nothing.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_revoke_invite_link
title: Revoke a shareable invite link
